flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3001/app then Verify Available quota reads "$4,500.00".
Click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" with a mouse click, as a user would.
Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers it; if the click does not reach it, the check fails.
Verify Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS".

remark: wait: Waiting stop after the mouse click missed the covered "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" button

summary:
The automation clicked at the wrong location instead of on the visible “+ Top Up Quota ($250)” control. The required follow-up checks therefore had no action to validate.
Fix the click targeting so the pointer lands on the center of the visible Top Up Quota control, and retain the rule that an obstructed or missed user click fails without retries.
one_liner: The required mouse click did not reach the Top Up Quota control, so the quota update could not be verified.
reason: The click missed the covered button, so the constraint prohibits waiting or working around it.

verdict.root_cause: The automation clicked at the wrong location instead of on the visible “+ Top Up Quota ($250)” control. The required follow-up checks therefore had no action to validate.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the outcome: at step 0-4 it attempted the required click, but the action marker is above the page title rather than on the visible Top Up Quota control. The screenshot also shows the quota still at $4,500.00 and status SYSTEM_READY. Because the task explicitly prohibited waiting for or working around coverage after a missed click, stopping was required; there is no evidence that the application itself failed.

verdict.suggestion: Fix the click targeting so the pointer lands on the center of the visible Top Up Quota control, and retain the rule that an obstructed or missed user click fails without retries.
